_note: Main quest chain (docs/STORY.md). cond kinds: told | collect{item,n} | craft{item,n} | placedVillage{n} | friend{species,n} | friends{n} | dex{n} | flag{flag}. needs = a gate that must hold before the giver can start the step (shows its own progress). markers = world pickups/interact spots (placeholders for the full companion-ability content).

steps.title: Welcome, Keeper!
steps.hint: Walk to Pip on the village green and press E to talk.

steps.title: Sawdust and Sparkle
steps.hint: Hold F (or click) on a tree trunk to gather 6 logs.

steps.title: Plank Plan
steps.hint: Press C for the Workbench and make some planks.

steps.title: A Roof Over Your Head
steps.hint: Place 20 blocks near the village green: pick a block (1-0), then press X.

steps.title: Hello, Little Light
steps.hint: Hold a berry, walk slowly up to a Puffbun and press E.

steps.title: Bram Arrives
steps.hint: Keep building near the green: 60 blocks make the village grow. Then say hi to Bram.

steps.title: The Ripple Lens
steps.hint: Befriend a Tidler at the pond (they love oranges). It will dive for the lens.

steps.title: The Whisper Lens
steps.hint: Befriend a Sprigfox in the forest (bring apples), then follow the glow to the old stump.

steps.title: The Cheer Lens
steps.hint: Climb the north path to the highland meadow and find the sparkly clover.

steps.title: Build the Beacon
steps.hint: Bring 10 cobble and the three lenses to the lighthouse pedestal. Press E there.

steps.title: Glimmerlight Night
steps.hint: The light is back! Join everyone on the village green for the festival.

steps.title: Village Wish: Cosy Corners
steps.hint: Decorate! Place 100 more blocks near the green: gardens, lamps, anything.

steps.title: Village Wish: Full Dex
steps.hint: Find all 9 Glimmers in the Glimmerdex (G).

steps.title: Village Wish: Many Friends
steps.hint: Make 6 Glimmer friends. Every friend lights up the village a little.
